news.title: Balakrishna Suggests Script Changes for Mokshagna's Launch Film
news.summary: Actor Balakrishna is closely overseeing the script development of his son Mokshagna's highly anticipated acting debut, directed by Mallidi Vasishta. After listening to the complete narration, the senior actor advised modifications particularly for the second half of the socio-fantasy project. The film aims to introduce Mokshagna in a unique setting rather than a standard commercial entertainer.

news.title: Allu Sirish Sparks Online Debate Over Late-Night Temple Noise
news.summary: Actor Allu Sirish raised concerns on social media regarding persistent loud music coming from a local temple near his Hyderabad residence late at night. While several users supported his stance against noise pollution, others questioned why he selectively targeted a Hindu institution. Local police have reportedly begun reviewing the complaint to address the disturbance.

news.title: Janhvi Kapoor Adopts a Selective Approach to New Film Signings
news.summary: Actress Janhvi Kapoor is keeping a low profile and taking time to carefully evaluate her upcoming career moves following her recent projects. She is reportedly shifting focus away from conventional glamorous roles toward more performance-driven characters. Meanwhile, rumors linking her to Allu Arjun's upcoming movie remain unconfirmed.

news.title: Emotional Character Glimpse Unveiled for Puri Jagannadh's Slum Dog
news.summary: The makers of Puri Jagannadh's action drama Slum Dog: 33 Temple Road have released a new promotional glimpse highlighting Zarina Wahab's emotional role as Zubeidaa. The upcoming film stars Vijay Sethupathi as a street-dweller turned vigilante alongside an ensemble cast including Tabu and Samyuktha. Slum Dog has completed its shooting phase and is heading toward a multi-language pan-India release.

news.title: Upcoming Friday Box Office Clash: Sigma and Dont Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: Following the theatrical run of Nani's The Paradise, audience attention has pivoted to the upcoming Friday releases, Sandeep Kishan's Sigma and Fahadh Faasil's Dont Trouble The Trouble. Both films are generating pre-release buzz across the southern states with extensive promotional events. Additionally, Keerthy Suresh's Karthik Subbaraj-directed project Dorothy is slated to arrive on October 2.

news.title: Ram Charan Starrer Peddi Locks Hindi Television Premiere Date
news.summary: Buchi Babu Sana's directorial venture Peddi, starring Ram Charan and Janhvi Kapoor, is scheduled for its Hindi TV debut on Sony MAX. The action drama will be broadcast on October 25, 2026, while a separate Telugu television premiere is rumored for the Dasara festival on ZEE Telugu. The Vriddhi Cinemas project features music by AR Rahman and supporting performances by Shiva Rajkumar and Jagapathi Babu.

news.title: Actor Allu Sirish Files Police Complaint Over Late-Night Shaikpet Noise
news.summary: Tollywood actor Allu Sirish reached out to the Hyderabad City Police via social media regarding persistent loud music near his Shaikpet residence. Responding to his grievance about late-night noise violating decibel limits past festival dates, authorities forwarded the matter to the Film Nagar Police Station. The incident has reignited local discussions concerning community volume levels and residential peace.

news.title: Zarina Wahab's Emotional Teaser Unveiled for Puri Jagannadh's Next
news.summary: The creators of Puri Jagannadh's pan-India film Slum Dog - 33 Temple Road released a character glimpse featuring veteran actress Zarina Wahab as Zubeidaa. Marking Puri Jagannadh's birthday, the promotional video highlights a tragic narrative underscored by Harshavardhan Rameshwar's musical score. The project is backed by producers Puri Jagannadh, Charmme Kaur, and JB Narayan Rao Kondrolla.

news.title: Rag Mayur's Anumanam Pakshi suffers heavily at the box office
news.summary: Rag Mayur's latest theatrical outing, Anumanam Pakshi, struggled to draw audiences after debuting on September 25. Playing against Nani's major release, the small-budget drama faced harsh reviews and negligible theatre occupancy. The Chilaka Productions project also marked Malayalam actress Merin Philip's Tollywood debut, which unfortunately resulted in a major commercial setback.

news.title: Sharvari stuns in navy mini dress at awards gala
news.summary: Actress Sharvari recently grabbed attention by winning the Spotlight Actor trophy at the Harper's Bazaar Women of the Year awards. She walked the event in a stylish navy pinstripe strapless mini dress paired with a matching draped blazer. On the professional front, she is currently awaiting the post-production release of Yeh Prem Mol Liya and working on an upcoming Ali Abbas Zafar project.

news.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga backed Romanchakam locks Netflix release
news.summary: The youthful romantic comedy Romanchakam is officially heading to Netflix for its digital premiere on October 1, 2026. Directed by newcomer Venu Gopal Reddy and starring Sumanth Prabhas alongside Ananthika Sanilkumar, the project will stream in multiple languages. Presented by Sandeep Reddy Vanga under Bhadrakali Pictures, the team hopes the OTT platform will give the theatrical underperformer a second chance.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses Major Box Office Milestone Despite Online Backlash
news.summary: Nani and Kayadu Lohar's latest starrer, directed by Srikanth Odela, has crossed an impressive Rs 138 crore worldwide in its first four days. Despite facing heavy negative chatter and mixed reviews on social media following its September 23 release, the movie has registered the highest-grossing opening weekend of the actor's career.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Unveils Peppy Opening Track
news.summary: The first single titled 'Narayanamma' from Victory Venkatesh and Trivikram Srinivas's upcoming family entertainer has officially dropped. Composed by Thaman S with vocals by Prabha and Ram Miriyala, the celebratory track features a high-energy dance performance by Dimple Hayathi alongside the lead cast.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Applauds Nani and Srikanth Odela's Gritty Drama
news.summary: BRS Working President K. T. Rama Rao attended a special screening of Nani's latest movie at Hyderabad's Sudarshan Theatre. He commended the director and the cast for delivering a powerful cinematic reflection of an oppressed community's struggle and identity rooted in Telangana culture.

news.title: Veteran Star Zarina Wahab Unveiled as Zubaida in Puri Jagannadh's Pan-India Project
news.summary: Makers of the pan-India action drama Slum Dog, directed by Puri Jagannadh and starring Vijay Sethupathi, have introduced veteran actress Zarina Wahab as Zubaida. Backed by Puri Connects and JB Motion Pictures, the film features a massive multi-industry ensemble cast and is slated for release in five languages.

news.title: Sidharth and Tamannaah's Supernatural Thriller Reports Growth
news.summary: Despite opening to predominantly negative feedback, the makers of The Vvaan claim the film picked up momentum on its second day. The fantasy folklore project, starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia, has grossed ₹23.5 crore worldwide so far. The upcoming weekend and weekday earnings will determine its ultimate box-office fate.

news.title: Remarkable Box Office Journey for Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: Starting with a modest opening, Hanuman Ansh has completed fifty days in theaters and surpassed the ₹400 crore gross mark globally. Built on a tiny budget, the film turned into a massive phenomenon with strong overseas numbers. Although it missed a Telugu distribution deal, it remains one of the most surprising hits in recent times.

news.title: Nani Starrer Faces Crucial Test After Strong Weekend
news.summary: Nani's latest cinematic outing, The Paradise, has shrugged off negative initial reviews and social media trolling to post impressive numbers. Benefiting from an extended holiday weekend, the film is on track to easily cross the ₹150 crore gross milestone during its opening days. Trade analysts note that the upcoming weekdays will serve as the true assessment of its box-office stamina.

news.title: First Single From Venkatesh and Trivikram's Upcoming Film Unveiled
news.summary: The musical promotional campaign for Aadarsha Kutumbam House No.47 has officially kicked off with the release of the track Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman S and featuring vocals by Prabha and Ram Miriyala, the event brought the core cast and crew together in Hyderabad. The feature is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Surprising Digital Purchase Price for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Big-Budget Period Movie
news.summary: The upcoming high-profile period film Love & War, featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal, has recently finalized its digital streaming agreement. Industry discussions have emerged because ZEE5 acquired the rights for approximately Rs 25 crore, a figure lower than anticipated given the massive scale of the project. Directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali, the venture is still on track for a wide theatrical rollout on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Psychological Love Story Kaasu Teases Audiences With Stylish Character Introductions
news.summary: Producers at AKR Dream Pictures LLP have showcased the first preview for Kaasu, highlighting a unique narrative where romance clashes with obsession and money. Headlined by Shree Nandu and Indu Kumar, the movie is helmed by director P.S. Harshavardhan with an emphasis on bold character attitudes and emotional twists. The project is planned for a multi-language release across Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, and Hindi markets.

news.title: Shared Responsibility: Why Entire Film Crews Own Box Office Outcomes
news.summary: In the entertainment industry, both commercial triumphs and failures stem from the combined efforts of an entire collaborative unit rather than a single individual. From writers and directors to actors, technicians, and financial producers, every department contributes to the final product reaching audiences. A misstep or brilliant contribution by anyone involved can ultimately alter a film's theatrical fate.

news.title: Venkatesh's Adarsha Kutumbam Kicks Off Promotions With First Single
news.summary: The musical campaign for Victory Venkatesh's family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam (AK47) has officially begun with the launch of the track Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman S and written by Ramajogayya Sastry, the festive dance number features Venkatesh alongside Dimple Hayati, Srinidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and produced by S. Radha Krishna, the film is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Prabhas Launches Unique Story Reveal Video For Gen-Z Romantic Comedy
news.summary: Rebel Star Prabhas has unveiled the story reveal video for the upcoming youthful movie Romeo Juliet, starring Harshit and Vishaka Dhiman. Directed by Bhargav Mucharla and produced by Sundeep N and Venkateswara Rao Challagulla, the film satirizes modern relationships and situationships. The unconventional project is slated to hit the big screen on October 23, coinciding with Prabhas' birthday.

news.title: Gen-Z Relationship Dynamics Take Center Stage In Romeo Juliet Glimpse
news.summary: The newly released story glimpse for Romeo Juliet dives straight into contemporary dating vocabularies like situationships, hookups, and benching. Headlined by Harshith and Vishaka Dhiman, the Bhargav Macharla directorial features music by Gopi Sundar and cinematography by Abhiraj Nair. Navarasa Entertainments is bringing the youth-centric movie to theaters on October 23 to mark Prabhas' birthday.

news.title: Venkatesh And Trivikram's Adarsha Kutumbam Drops Festive Track Narayanamma
news.summary: The promotional rollout for Venkatesh's upcoming family drama Adarsha Kutumbam has officially started with the release of its first single, Narayanamma. The mass dance track features energetic performances from Dimple Hayathi, Sreenidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj alongside the lead actor. Backed by Haarika & Hassine Creations, the film hits cinemas on October 9.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Unveils Energetic First Single
news.summary: The makers of the upcoming Telugu film Aadarsha Kutumbam have released its first single titled Narayanamma. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and starring Venkatesh, the track features dynamic dance choreography by Dimple Hayathi alongside the lead cast. Composed by Thaman with vocals by Prabha Bangarigalla and Ram Miriyala, the folk-beat number has generated massive online buzz.

news.title: Blockbuster Malayalam Romance Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Locks OTT Premiere
news.summary: The smash-hit Malayalam romantic comedy Bethlehem Kudumba Unit, starring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju, has officially scheduled its digital debut on JioHotstar. Directed by Girish AD, the movie shattered box office records to become a major grosser in Kerala and will soon stream in multiple languages, including Telugu.

news.title: Digital Streaming Date Announced for Blockbuster Hit Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
news.summary: Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju's romantic comedy drama Bethlehem Kudumba Unit is heading to digital platforms following a phenomenal theatrical run. The Girish A.D. directorial is set to begin streaming on JioHotstar from October 2, following a historic box-office performance worldwide. The film features music by Vishnu Vijay and a supporting cast including Dileesh Pothan and Vinay Forrt.

news.title: Tamil Star Suriya Advises Supporters to Avoid Online Disputes
news.summary: During a recent gathering with fan club members, prominent actor Suriya requested his admirers to steer clear of internet negativity and pointless controversies. He encouraged them to channel their energy into personal productivity instead of reacting to critics. The actor emphasized the importance of spreading positivity and maintaining focus on individual goals.
